Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Medicine MBChB at University of Edinburgh

What University of Edinburgh asks of applicants to Medicine MBChB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Edinburgh courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 3 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma (Medicine): at least three AP test scores at grade 5 are required, including Chemistry and two from Biology, Physics, Math/Calculus, plus the UCAT
  • The general US routes (SAT/ACT + APs, or a high-school transcript) do not apply to MBChB Medicine

Edinburgh’s US page states the Medicine requirement as three AP scores at grade 5 and says the transcript route does not apply; it does not say whether an SAT or ACT score can replace an AP for Medicine.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Edinburgh: Undergraduate entry requirements — United States of America
English language
  • IELTS Academic: 7.5 overall with at least 7.5 in each component (IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted)
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 110 overall with at least 25 in each component (tests before 21 January 2026)
    • 5.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each component (tests from 21 January 2026)
    • TOEFL MyBest not accepted
  • C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency:
    • 191 overall with at least 191 in each component
    • Oxford ELLT: 9 in each component
    • Oxford Test of English Advanced: 165 in each component
  • IELTS, TOEFL iBT and Oxford tests must be no more than two years old at the programme start date
  • US nationals (a majority English-speaking country) can instead use, for example, Grade 11 English at C, ACT 25 in both English and Reading, or SAT 650 in Reading and Writing
Verified19 Oct 2026Edinburgh: MBChB Medicine (6-year programme) entry requirements · Edinburgh: Undergraduate entry requirements — United States of America
Admissions tests
  • UCAT — required, sat in the same year as the UCAS application
  • A minimum UCAT score is required (except for Plus Flag widening access applicants)
  • A Band 4 in the UCAT Situational Judgement section means the application will not be considered
Verified19 Oct 2026Edinburgh: MBChB Medicine (6-year programme) entry requirements
Subject prerequisites
  • Required at A level: Chemistry, plus one of Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics/Further Mathematics or Physics
  • GCSE Biology, Chemistry, English and Mathematics at A or 7

Chemistry is required; the second subject is one of Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics/Further Mathematics or Physics — a one-of choice the engine cannot hold, so only Chemistry is matched. The GCSE line (Biology, Chemistry, English, Mathematics at A or 7) is not in this row's snippet.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement:
    • 3 AP exams
    • Not counted: AP Research
  • MBChB Medicine:
    • at least three AP test scores at grade 5
    • required subjects Chemistry and two from Biology, Physics, Math/Calculus (AP Math or AP Calculus can meet one)
  • AP scores are used for admissions only; no advanced credit is awarded
Verified19 Oct 2026Edinburgh: Undergraduate entry requirements — United States of America
Other requirements
  • Interview: required (multiple mini-interviews)
  • Fitness to practise is assessed; health clearance checks are required if you gain a place
  • Resit qualifications are not normally accepted (only in very exceptional, evidenced circumstances)

Partly verified: Edinburgh’s interviews, tests and portfolios page still refers to the UCAT “in 2025” (the previous cycle).
